title: Shopping Mode
summary: Turn any note into a distraction-free shopping trip.

cards.heading: What Shopping Mode does
cards.body: Shopping Mode strips away everything except your list. Items are grouped by supermarket department so you shop the store in order.

cards.heading: Starting a trip
cards.body: Open any note with a checklist and tap the shopping cart. Iron Rabbit sorts the items into Produce, Dairy, Bakery, and more.

cards.heading: Ticking items off
cards.body: Tap an item to strike it through. Missed one? Tap again to bring it back. Your list stays saved even if you close the app mid-trip.

cards.heading: Tip: Combine multiple lists
cards.body: Tip: Building one big trip? Merge several notes into one in the note editor first, then open Shopping Mode. One list, one trip, no phone juggling.

cards.heading: Common mistake
cards.body: Deleted items are gone for good. If you're not sure, keep them ticked off instead — you can copy the note to reuse next week.
